reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful
reviews.comment: This case is amazing. Lot's of room for whatever you want. Cables hide in the back nicely. Just looks cool. Cons you have to check the size of the PSU because as you can see it does not cover the bottom panel. No white options.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Best PC Case Hands Down!
reviews.comment: This is the GREATEST computer case of all time!!! Yes it is probably the most expensive non-custom case and yes it is an absolute beast both in size and weight. This is not for the average PC user. This case is if you want the best building experience and the best possible full-size mass-manufactured computer case on the market. The cable management is supreme, there is virtually no noise from the on board fans, the aRGB colour is fantastic and connects with the ASUS Amroury Crate device management software. It is super easy to build in this case and even a first time PC builder like me figured it out with ease. I have now made two builds in this case and swapping components is a breeze. Overall, if you made it this far, just buy the case you won’t regret it.
reviews.author: James Remley

reviews.title: It's impressive. Let's see how it holds up.
reviews.comment: I wanted a nice case for my new computer build. I've never spent this much on a case but I figured if I'm going to look at my PC every day I might as well like the view. Even though this case is full featured. I feel like it could be better in terms of cable routing. I also found that even with an ASUS ROG strix 870E motherboard I did not have enough internal connectors for both USB 4 front panel headers. I think this is a shortsight of ASUS given that I'm using their own products. I think the sliding tool tray is just a gimmick.  It's okay for the aesthetics but doesn't really provide any real functionality.
reviews.author: Mike Khashaiar Kojoori

reviews.title: Absolute unit
reviews.comment: This chassis is an absolute tank. Massive is an understatement. You will need plenty of room to house this beast. The advantage of having a chassis of this caliber, is that there is plenty of room to work without overcrowding fans and radiators. I was able to fit an ATX ASUS ROG Strix motherboard with a 420 mm radiator, a 360mm radiator fan for my GPU, the included 420mm intake fans, with plenty of space to spare.
reviews.author: Andreas Donahoe

reviews.title: It's that good
reviews.comment: The assembly of this case was one of the best and easiest cases I've ever built in. This year size and the ability to run without being heard The dust filters is just a plus The functionality of this setup was amazing
